data: Which of the following progression types are represented in the figure?

The figure shows three different progression types: Arithmetic Progression, Geometric Progression, and Harmonic Progression. The lines representing these progressions are colored red, blue, and green, respectively. The caption confirms this by stating that the distributions of popularity scores calculated by arithmetic, geometric, and harmonic progressions are shown on the same datasets. Therefore, the progression types represented in the figure are Arithmetic Progression, Geometric Progression, and Harmonic Progression.
